verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a virtual mailbox service, which holds scanned mail and account records, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows per-letter PDF scans, online storage and the ability to cancel; none of it documents a bulk export of all account data in open formats. Those are adjacent features, not an export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
